security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: asset:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Voice dictation and voice commands for your desktop
bundle.longDescription: OpenDictate turns your voice into text in any app. Tap a key to dictate, hold it to speak a command that rewrites the selected text or writes something new. Works with OpenRouter, OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, Gemini, Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible server.
